decisions.boundary_condition: Apply only to hotel or room amenity selection after satisfying explicit trip constraints such as dates, destination, occupancy, and required amenities.
decisions.condition: When evaluating hotel room amenities and otherwise suitable lodging options are available, the user prefers a room that includes an in-room wet bar.
decisions.default_action: Rank otherwise suitable hotel rooms higher when they include an in-room wet bar.
decisions.exception_condition: If no otherwise suitable room with a wet bar is available, or the user explicitly prioritizes another hotel factor, proceed without the wet bar rather than blocking the booking.
decisions.name: Prefer hotel rooms with an in-room wet bar
decisions.rationale: Supported by multiple hotel-search examples where the user asks for or positively values an in-room wet bar. This is a recurring hotel room amenity preference, not an alias of the coffeemaker or fireplace preferences and not a hard requirement in all cases.

decisions.boundary_condition: Apply only to hotel or lodging searches where room-level amenities are relevant; do not apply this to flights, car rentals, destination choice, dates, party size, or unrelated lodging constraints.
decisions.condition: When searching for hotel lodging and room-level comfort amenities are being compared, the user prefers rooms that include a fireplace.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize otherwise suitable hotel rooms that explicitly list a fireplace.
decisions.exception_condition: If no otherwise suitable room with a fireplace is available, or explicit requirements conflict with it, surface the tradeoff and proceed or ask whether to relax the fireplace preference.
decisions.name: Prefer hotel rooms with a fireplace
decisions.rationale: Supported by repeated hotel-room requests mentioning a fireplace as a desired amenity. The evidence supports a soft room-amenity preference, while allowing explicit trip constraints or availability to override it.

decisions.boundary_condition: Apply only to hotel room amenity selection after satisfying explicit trip constraints; do not infer a preferred destination, view, bed type, star rating, breakfast plan, or unrelated amenity from this preference.
decisions.condition: When selecting a hotel room and in-room amenities are part of the lodging search, the user prefers rooms that include a coffeemaker.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize otherwise suitable hotel rooms that include an in-room coffeemaker.
decisions.exception_condition: If no room with a coffeemaker satisfies the explicit trip constraints, or the traveler explicitly deprioritizes the amenity for that stay, choose an otherwise suitable room without requiring a coffeemaker.
decisions.name: Prefer hotel rooms with a coffeemaker
decisions.rationale: Supported by several independent hotel-room requests that include a coffeemaker. This is a recurring in-room amenity preference and is not semantically equivalent to the wet bar preference, even though they co-occur in one example.
